# Enhance Automation Reliability and Safe Delivery Paths

This issue aims to ensure that automation workflows are robust, resilient, and free from dependency issues, particularly in the context of Telegram outreach and OpenClaw mirror swarm dependencies.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Ensure all automation tasks are tested and verified for reliability.
- Fix any dependency issues in the mirror swarm and Telegram integration.
- Implement safeguards to prevent failures in critical workflows.
- Document the fixes and improvements in the issue for future reference.

## Related Work
- Fixes for dependency issues in the mirror swarm (e.g., commits #455, #453).
- Improvements in Telegram outreach and bot routing (e.g., commits #446, #448).
- Safe delivery path enhancements for OpenClaw automation.
